places.name: Evel Knievel's Snake River Canyon Jump Site
places.description: Where the famed daredevil attempted to launch himself across a canyon in a custom-built rocket.

places.name: Twin Falls Waterfall
places.description: One of the "twins" in these falls on the Snake River was sacrificed for hydropower generation in the 1930s.

places.name: I. B. Perrine Bridge
places.description: The only bridge in the United States where BASE jumping is legal without a permit year-round.

places.name: Balanced Rock
places.description: This hulking rock formation balances on a pedestal that is 3 feet by 17 inches.
